title: ever EMBER|Glitter Twist Knot See-Through Long Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Warm reminder: Please iron after unpacking for best results!

Make an unforgettable entrance with this Glitter Twist Knot See-Through Long Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress. Featuring a shimmering fabric and a flattering twist knot detail, this dress beautifully accentuates your waistline. The sheer long sleeves add an alluring touch, perfect for weddings and elegant evening events.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Tea length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises polyester.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
